symbols.name: ActiveEntityContext
symbols.summary: Represents a context for Active Entity operations, bundling the provider and behaviors resolved from the same DI scope. This ensures that the provider and behaviors share the same lifetime and dependencies (e.g., DbContext). Lifetime Warning: This context is only valid within the DI scope it was created from. Do not cache or pass it across async boundaries outside of that scope, as it may lead to System.ObjectDisposedException if the underlying scope (and its services) are disposed. Always use it immediately within the creating method (e.g., inside BridgingIT.DevKit.Domain.ActiveEntityContextScope or a WithTransactionAsync operation). If you need to extend the context with more dependencies, resolve them at creation time and add them as properties here, rather than resolving them later to avoid scope mismatches.
symbols.remarks: Initializes a new instance of the BridgingIT.DevKit.Domain.ActiveEntityContext%602 class.

symbols.name: Provider
symbols.summary: Gets the provider used for CRUD operations and transactions. This provider is bound to the DI scope the context was created from.

symbols.name: Behaviors
symbols.summary: Gets the collection of behaviors (lifecycle hooks) resolved from the same DI scope as the provider. These behaviors are executed before/after CRUD operations.
